en.headline: Thunderstorm warning in force until 5am amid heavy rain risk
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has the Thunderstorm Warning in effect until 5 a.m., with intense rain bands near the Pearl River Estuary and widespread heavy rain possible in the next few hours.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Thunderstorm Warning remains in force until 5 a.m. on Monday, with isolated thunderstorms expected over Hong Kong.

In its local weather report issued at 12.31 a.m., the Observatory noted that intense rain bands were persistently affecting the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary and that widespread heavy rain may affect the territory in the next few hours. Members of the public were advised to stay alert.

Temperatures at the Observatory stood at 25 degrees Celsius with relative humidity at 94 per cent around midnight. The forecast for the day points to mainly cloudy conditions with occasional showers and thunderstorms, which may be heavy at times at first, and temperatures ranging between 25 and 28 degrees.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至清晨5時 廣泛大雨風險
zh.dek: 天文台表示雷暴警告繼續生效至今日上午5時，珠江口一帶有強烈雨帶持續影響，未來數小時本港廣泛地區可能受大雨影響。
body: 香港天文台表示，雷暴警告繼續生效至今日上午5時，預期本港有局部地區出現雷暴。
天文台於凌晨12時31分發出的本地天氣報告指出，珠江口一帶有強烈雨帶持續影響，未來數小時本港廣泛地區可能受大雨影響，呼籲市民提高警覺。
午夜時分天文台氣溫為25度，相對濕度94%。預料今日大致多雲，間中有驟雨及雷暴，初時雨勢有時頗大，氣溫介乎25至28度。
